name: Jessica Patton Vlaco
office: City of Rancho Palos Verdes, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jessica Patton Vlaco has a career in accounting and finance.

sentences.text: Jessica Patton Vlaco has a career in accounting and finance.

items.text: At an October 2026 candidate forum, she said she would focus on public safety, including crime and fire prevention, and home hardening and landslide remediation. She supports seeking additional funding for landslide mitigation. She considers road repairs and maintenance a top priority. On a new Civic Center, she said the city should first overcome land use hurdles before developing a plan.
